state:
- The tested population stays at primary AML that “retains a differentiation block,” with genetic breadth mentioned only as a limitation, so a negative or positive result can be reassigned to an unspecified subset. Pre-specify a baseline immaturity measure, require same-sample DHODH-pathway suppression, and state which samples fall outside the claim.
- The validation plan lists assays, an unnamed experimental DHODH-inhibitor control, and uridine rescue while leaving the rescue metabolite, pharmacodynamic analytes, free-exposure ceiling, and decision thresholds unspecified. Name the control compound and metabolite readout, set a free-concentration bound, and lock pre-set cutoffs for markers, viability, oxygen consumption, and the normal-versus-AML colony ratio.
- The core claim is the nearest approved inhibitor of the enzyme already tied to differentiation in S4; the ROS-low, cytarabine-residual, and venetoclax–azacitidine arms mostly restate packet boundaries. Add a prediction S4 alone does not entail, such as a graded link between pyrimidine-pool depletion and maturation under matched pathway suppression.
